PRIVATE AI DECISION INTELLIGENCE

A wider view of the data you are authorised to use.

Every report has a boundary. Dimaq™ broadens the inquiry across connected enterprise data, relating business context and evidence to the actions that deserve your attention.

01

Connect the business picture

Explore relationships across finance, sales, inventory, purchasing, projects and operations.

02

Prepare for a meaningful review

Ask follow-up questions, examine supporting evidence and bring proposed actions to the discussion.

03

Work across platforms

Configured integrations can connect SAP, Odoo, Tally, Salesforce and ServiceNow environments.

04

Keep your administrator in control

Manage users, roles, approved data scope, model access, logging and retention through agreed administration policies.

EXPLORE THE APPROACH

Ask a bigger business question.

Finance / illustrative example

Where might cash collection need attention?

Relate overdue receivables, disputes and customer commitments within your permitted records.

Evidence to examine

Invoice ageing · disputes · promised payment dates

Possible next step

Prioritise an account review and validate the cause with its owner.

Sales / illustrative example

Which customer commitments could be at risk?

Connect open orders with availability, planned supply and promised dates.

Evidence to examine

Order lines · available stock · supply commitments

Possible next step

Review at-risk commitments with sales and operations.

Operations / illustrative example

What keeps the same issue coming back?

Explore recurring exceptions across incidents, process steps and operational context.

Evidence to examine

Exception history · ownership · process dependencies

Possible next step

Bring a recurring pattern to the review and assign an investigation.

Illustrative workflow, not a live product response. Actual behaviour depends on approved sources, integrations, scope and permissions.

PRIVATE AI ADVANTAGE

Useful intelligence.
Defined boundaries.

Dimaq™ supports an Amazon Bedrock-based deployment in your AWS environment.

Customer-controlled deployment

Design the environment around approved business knowledge, data access and operating policies.

AWS-managed model access

Use approved managed language models, with model, region, logging and retention settings agreed for the deployment.

Administrator-led boundaries

Define who can use the system, which data they can access and how integrations and knowledge updates are governed.

Privacy and access controls depend on the agreed deployment configuration and connected services. Validate permissions, data handling and human escalation before rollout.

A PRACTICAL WAY FORWARD

From understanding to action.

01

Connect

Read approved sources through configured integrations.

02

Understand

Map data structures, business definitions and domain context.

03

Synthesize

Examine relationships across the user’s authorised data.

04

Advise

Present evidence and proposed actions for leadership review.

Scope & fit

Coverage depends on connected sources, data quality and permissions. Integration depends on connectors, APIs, versions and customisations. Dimaq™ is an advisory layer: leaders retain decision and execution authority. Private AI configuration, model, AWS Region, logging and retention settings are agreed during deployment.
